## Overview

This skill analyzes TypeScript code and reports quality issues.

## When to use

Trigger this skill when the user asks to review TypeScript code, check for anti-patterns,
or wants improvement suggestions on a codebase.

## Usage

```bash
/my-good-skill
```

## Steps

1. Read the relevant source files
2. Identify issues (types, patterns, naming)
3. Report findings with severity levels
4. Suggest concrete improvements

## Examples

```
User: Review my TypeScript code for quality issues.
Assistant: [invokes my-good-skill]
```
